<!-- pr-reviewer: bce5362ef433d0f136ee4821f3761beb183f0ecb -->
Reviewer: PR-reviewer agent (Claude Opus 5.5), dispatched by session m5bob via /review-prs on 2026-11-26 (UTC); this agent did not write the change.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a re-review of the unchanged head `bce5362ef`. The earlier needs-changes verdict asked only for before and after screenshots, and they are now in the PR body.

What looks good
- Both image links return 200 `image/png`. The "Before (97a676e5c)" image shows Simulate with the Stock row hidden (the eye is struck out in the Browser) and nothing under the transport row. The "After (bce5362ef)" image shows the same state with the note under the transport: "The stock is hidden, so the material removal is not shown. Show the Stock row in the Browser to see it."
- The shas make sense. 97a676e5c is the branch point and is an ancestor of `upstream/main`. bce5362ef is this head.
- Display-only change with no command, nothing undoable, and nothing the post or the Deviate verdict reads. `docs/decisions/3315-hidden-stock-hint.md` records the choice of hint over a forced stock body. The pinning test is `a_hidden_stock_is_said_under_the_transport`.
- No snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no process files, no dependency or build changes. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #3315`.

Results merged with main
- Trial merge with current `upstream/main`: clean, no conflicts. The three touched files (`crates/ui/src/play_precalc.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/transport_precalc.rs`, the decision doc) are unchanged on main since the branch point.
- Not rebuilt in this re-review, because the trial merge does not change any touched file and the code and head are unchanged since the earlier full build and test pass on this head. The author's own quick gate (10 steps, 0 failed) and the `camcraft-ui` clippy `-D warnings` are cited in the body.

Targeted tests (step 5)
- No post or toolpath change, so the example catalog suites do not apply. The diff reaches no heavy lane. P7, so no heavy step.

| Step | Result | Head | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`) | Not run | `bce5362ef433d0f136ee4821f3761beb183f0ecb` | Not run in this re-review (docs-style re-check of an unchanged head, no rebuild). A red light run would only be a note. |

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The body says "No check by hand in the GUI". The screenshots come from the off-screen renderer, so they support the AccessKit test.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
